title: Pure Mist Virginia 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Virginia delivers the timeless taste of classic Virginia Tobacco, offering a smooth, earthy, and well-rounded flavour profile. This authentic e-liquid is ideal for vapers who enjoy traditional tobacco blends with a subtle sweetness. The Pure Mist High-PG collection caters to different vaping preferences with tailored VG/PG ratios. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Virginia is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
